title: Durable Agent Workflows with Temporal: Surviving Crashes Without Checkpointing Hacks
excerpt: A hand-rolled status column breaks the moment a worker dies mid-step. Here's how Temporal's Workflow/Activity split survives crashes and long human approvals without one.
seo_title: Durable Agent Workflows with Temporal: Crash Recovery
meta_description: Durable agent workflows with Temporal survive crashes and long human approvals, no hand-rolled checkpoint table. Real Python code, retries, and pitfalls.
social_message:
I built a database table just to track which step my agent loop had reached. A worker crash duplicated a Slack message before I ripped it out.

Durable agent workflows with Temporal fix this: Workflows replay from event history, Activities retry on their own, and crash recovery uses the same mechanism as waiting on a human approval. Real RetryPolicy code, the OpenAI Agents SDK plugin, and the determinism bug that bit me first.

Read the full guide 👉 https://www.firstevolvenextscale.com/durable-agent-workflows-temporal/
